labs.title: Lab 1: Getting Started
labs.description: Set up Bob, scan your workspace, initialize Agent.md, and generate a Data Dictionary.

labs.title: Lab 2: Technical Design Document
labs.description: Generate a comprehensive technical design document from your COBOL codebase with Mermaid diagrams.

labs.title: Lab 3: Application Discovery & Understanding
labs.description: Explore call graphs, DB2 access graphs, flow charts, complexity reports, and variable data flow across the GENAPP application.

labs.title: Lab 4: Impact Analysis
labs.description: Analyze the ripple effects of a field change across your entire mainframe application landscape.

labs.title: Lab 5: Dead Code & Technical Debt
labs.description: Surface unreachable paragraphs, unused variables, and orphaned copybooks, then rank every program by a weighted technical debt scorecard.

labs.title: Lab 6: Refactoring & Service Extraction
labs.description: Identify business rules in monolithic COBOL programs, check dependencies, and extract business services for modernization.

labs.title: Lab 7: Spec-Driven Code Generation
labs.description: Use a program specification to generate a complete CICS COBOL program and verify it against requirements.

labs.title: ☕ Lab 1: Liberty Replatforming
labs.description: Migrate a legacy pharmacy app from Traditional WebSphere to Liberty runtime using Bob's Java Modernization workflow. Covers migration plan analysis, interactive approval flow, and deployment validation.

labs.title: ☕ Lab 2: Java Upgrade (8 → 21)
labs.description: Upgrade the pharmacy app from Java 8 to Java 21 with Jakarta EE 10. Covers OpenRewrite recipes, mid-workflow CVE scanning, Struts 2→7 ActionSupport rewrite, and the visual modernization summary.

labs.title: ☕ Lab 3: UI Modernization
labs.description: Migrate the pharmacy frontend from legacy Struts/JSP to a modern React + Material UI SPA, backed by Jakarta EE REST services, using Bob's Java UI Modernization workflow.

labs.title: ☕ Lab 4: Unit Test Generation
labs.description: Generate a comprehensive JUnit 5 test suite with Mockito and JaCoCo coverage using Bob's standalone Java Unit Testing workflow. Covers batch subagent generation, 80% confidence previews, and coverage reports.

labs.title: ☕ Lab Alt-4: Test Driven Development
labs.description: Implement API-first TDD from an OpenAPI 3.0 spec — generate tests before writing code, implement PrescriptionResource driven by those tests, and compare TDD vs traditional development outcomes.

labs.title: ☕ Lab 5: Security Vulnerability Remediation
labs.description: Scan the pharmacy app's full dependency tree for CVEs using Bob's Java Vulnerabilities Detection workflow, then remediate each finding through an interactive approval flow and verify a clean re-scan.
